subject: Kickoff: multilingual NMT representation analysis at scale
body: Team — kickoff on scaling up our multilingual-NMT representation analysis (the Investigating M4 line of work). The release ships the Colab and data for SVCCA-based analysis: model_scores.csv holds SVCCA similarity between language-pair activations across layers and checkpoints, and the finetuning files track relative BLEU change plus post-finetuning representation shift. The product question for the language portfolio: when we finetune our multilingual models for a priority language pair, which other pairs' representations move, and can we predict the BLEU regressions before they land? Milestones: repro the released plots by March 6; extend the SVCCA tooling to our current production multilingual model by mid-May; regression-prediction readout in July feeding H2 capacity planning. Alina will circulate staffing; Quentin is analysis lead. — Priya
